description: Text-to-image generation for AI agents, powered by fal.ai (Flux Schnell): send a prompt and get a generated image URL in seconds, for thumbnails, illustrations, mockups and visual assets inside agent workflows. The model is fixed server-side to fal-ai/flux/schnell so the per-call price always holds. No fal.ai account, API key or subscription needed: pay per call in USDC via x402.
name: image-generate
